LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_MarkOne.label: Mr.Handy-Mark 1
LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_MarkOne.description: Mr. Handy-Mark1 is an early household and militaire multipurpose flottant robot developed by General Atomics International. With a canon-shaped à énergie nucléaire corps, rotatif détecteur tête, and six flexible mécanique bras, it can perform maintenance, cargo handling, domestique work, and even arme operation. Though limited by its simple cerveau informatique and prone to failure without proper maintenance, its durable design allowed many units to remain operational for decades.
LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_MarkOne.tools.0.label: mécanique bras
LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_Mark1Military.label: militaire Mr.Handy-Mark 1
LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_Mark1Military.descripti: An early militaire conversion of the Mr. Handy-Mark 1 rather than a member of the later Mister Gutsy line. Its six bras carry a double machine-pistolet system, a circular scie, a lourd pince, and two general-purpose manipulators. The two supérieur-bras firing ports form a unique arme system. When not drafted for combat, its intégrée tools can also perform general manufacturing and clear unwanted vegetation.
LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_NexGen.label: Mr. Handy
LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_NexGen.description: A compact de nouvelle génération Mister Handy built around a tri-optic détecteur tête, central hover propulseur and avancé neural processeur. It lacks the rugged construction frame of the older Mark 1, but its intégrée manipulators, close-defense lance-flammes and domestique programming make it a capable high-end assistant for cooking, tailoring, manufacturing, hauling, firefighting and cleaning.
LanguageData.Mech_MisterHandy_NexGen.tools.0.label: manipulateur bras
LanguageData.Mech_MisterFarmhand.label: Mr. Farmhand
LanguageData.Mech_MisterFarmhand.description: A standardized agricole travail model derived from the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy plateforme. Its simplified processeur, close-defense lance-flammes and reinforced farm casing make it cheaper to gester than the full civilian model, but its programming is limited to crop work, plant cutting, hauling, firefighting and cleaning.
LanguageData.Mech_MisterFarmhand.tools.0.label: manipulateur bras
LanguageData.Mech_MisterOrderly.label: Mister Orderly
LanguageData.Mech_MisterOrderly.description: A médical and recherche derivative of the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy plateforme. Unlike the standardized travail models, the Orderly keeps a high subcore and avancé processeur package for clinical care, laboratoire assistance, hauling, firefighting and cleaning. Its precision surgical tool is useful in emergencies, but it is not a purpose-built arme. It can conduct technological recherche at recherche benches. It also performs crafting work, including medicine production and stonecutting.
LanguageData.Mech_MisterOrderly.tools.0.label: surgical scalpel
LanguageData.Mech_MissNanny.label: Miss Nanny
LanguageData.Mech_MissNanny.description: A personality-enabled childcare, médical and social-care derivative of the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy plateforme. Built around a high subcore and refined interpersonal routines, Miss Nanny can care for patients and children, manage prisoners, haul supplies, fight fires and keep domestique spaces clean. It can also be ordered to negotiate with visiting traders.
LanguageData.Mech_MissNanny.tools.0.label: manipulateur bras
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsy.tools.0.label: militaire pince
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsy.label: Mr. Gutsy
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsy.description: A dedicated militaire derivative of the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy. Its compact spherical châssis retains the tri-optic détecteur array and central hover propulseur, but replaces domestique manipulators with a 10mm mitraillette, an bras-mounted lance-flammes and a militaire pince. léger armor plating protects the châssis without sacrificing the maneuverability for which the series is known.
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsyLieutenant.tools.0.label: militaire pince
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsyLieutenant.label: Lieutenant Mr. Gutsy
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsyLieutenant.description: A field-command variant positioned between the standard Mr. Gutsy and the elite colonel model. Its reinforced compact châssis carries an automatique laser fusil for accurate rapid fire while retaining the bras-mounted lance-flammes and militaire pince of the Gutsy line.
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsyColonel.tools.0.label: militaire pince
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsyColonel.label: Colonel Mr. Gutsy
LanguageData.Mech_MisterGutsyColonel.description: An elite command-grade Mr. Gutsy built around a high subcore. avancé militaire armor protects its compact châssis, while a focalisé laser fusil delivers precise three-shot volleys capable of piercing lourd protection and setting targets alight. It is faster and more efficient than a centipede, but lacks the immense structural redundancy of that lourd mécanoïde.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Gun_Mark1DualMachinePistol.d: A pair of compact machine pistolets intégrée into the supérieur bras of a militaire Mr. Handy-Mark 1. Both firing ports are controlled as a unique arme system.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Gun_Gutsy10mmSMG.label: intégrée 10mm mitraillette
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Gun_Gutsy10mmSMG.description: A compact 10mm mitraillette installed directly into a Mr. Gutsy bras module. Its short, controlled bursts provide reliable fire at close and medium range.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Bullet_Gutsy10mm.label: 10mm mitraillette balle
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Gun_GutsyAutomaticLaserRifle: A rapid-fire AER-pattern laser fusil intégrée into a lieutenant Mr. Gutsy's arme bras. It trades some precision and rayon intensity for a sustained five-shot burst.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Gun_GutsyFocusedLaserRifle.d: A command-grade AER-pattern laser fusil intégrée into a colonel Mr. Gutsy's arme bras. Its focusing assembly fires three powerful long-range beams, with lengthy aiming and cooling cycles between volleys.
